panels.scene_en: an autumn evening street decorated with glowing jack-o-lanterns, fairy lights and fallen orange leaves
Natalka the little witch walks bravely down the street with Sofie in her ghost costume and black dog Stinek, who growls a little
an old empty-looking house with a creaking half-open door, cobwebs and a full moon behind it, spooky but not scary
